summary: Iter222 — HartaBlocuri Phase 1 (conflict resolution + typology + client PTR + admin 4-tab UI). BACKEND (8/8 pytest): admin cookie auth OK. GET /api/admin/hartablocuri/conflicts?unresolved_only=true → returns buildings with review-status conflicts. GET /api/admin/hartablocuri/buildings/{id} → returns context/conflicts/typology/hartablocuri/residents_count; typology has all 9 required cells (period/year/era/height_regime/structure/entrances/apartments/rooms_breakdown/neighborhood) each with {raw, normalized, source='HartaBlocuri'}. POST .../conflicts/resolve confirm → context[field]=HB value, status='confirmed', chosen_source='HartaBlocuri', HB raw preserved. reject → chosen_value=PropManage value, status='rejected', chosen_source='PropManage', context unchanged. Invalid field → 404. Client attach-building + GET /api/properties/{id}/building-context → building.hartablocuri {source_name='HartaBlocuri', verification_status='neverificat', fields{}, plan_urls[], reference_url} and building.verification_status='unverified'. Regresie: public search /api/public/buildings/search?q=Muscel OK; POST /api/buildings (client role) still creates manual PropManage-only buildings visible in admin list. FRONTEND (Playwright, 1440x900): /admin/hartablocuri loads with hb-admin-page + 4 tabs (hb-tab-overview/batches/buildings/conflicts). Overview stats render (3406 total, 3404 HB, 2 conflicts). Buildings tab: hb-b-source=hartablocuri filter → 30 rows; hb-b-status=conflict → 2 rows. Batches tab lists 3 batches. Conflicts tab: 1 building (Maia Zorilor 2) with 3 confirm/3 reject buttons for lat/lng/number_of_units. Clicking hb-resolve-confirm-<id>-number_of_units → conflict removed (2 confirm buttons remain). Client PTR: property Skyline Loft A4 attached to HB Muscel bloc — ptr-building-section renders ptr-hartablocuri-card with 'neverificat' badge + ptr-hb-unverified-note='Date externe HartaBlocuri — neverificate de PropManage' + HB fields (Bloc A2, Cluj-Napoca, Andrei Mureșanu, coords 46.7647/23.6032, era, apartamente, scari, lift, rooms_breakdown). All acceptance criteria met.

issues: Field labels (Nume, Adresă, Localitate, Cartier, Era, Regim, Apartamente etc.) rendered in a very dim amber tone on amber-50/40 bg — low contrast vs values. Consider bumping label color to amber-800 or slate-700 for readability.

action_items: (design polish, non-blocking) Bump HartaBlocuri card field-label contrast in PropertyTechnicalRecord.jsx
critical_code_review_comments: hartablocuri.py L142 — `result.pop('error_samples', None) if False else None` still present; dead code. Remove.

hartablocuri.py admin_resolve_conflict: history push doesn't include a resolution timestamp per-item (uses shared 'now') — fine, but consider adding action='confirm|reject' explicitly to history entry (not just via status/chosen_source) for easier auditing.

hartablocuri.py admin_list_conflicts: when unresolved_only=false the code returns ALL conflicts including resolved ones (status confirmed/rejected). Consider surfacing counts by status for UI filtering.

property_technical_record.py _serialize_building: hb.get('verification_status','neverificat') mixes RO 'neverificat' with the top-level 'unverified' vocabulary — intentional per spec, but UI must always render label from HB-specific dictionary.
hartablocuri.py public_cities() still iterates full buildings scan (3400+ docs) per request — noted in iter221; consider $group aggregation + short cache.
